# Subsequent references

First citation.[^1] Ibid.[^2] Ibid with a different pinpoint.[^3] Another source.[^4] Back to the first by its short title.[^5] Two sources in one footnote, with signals.[^6] The AGLC3 form "above n", exported as written.[^7] Ibid after a signal.[^8]

[^1]: *Mabo v Queensland [No 2]* (1992) 175 CLR 1, 42 ('*Mabo*').
[^2]: Ibid.
[^3]: Ibid 58.
[^4]: Lisa Strelein, *Compromised Jurisprudence: Native Title Cases since Mabo* (Aboriginal Studies Press, 2nd ed, 2009) 45.
[^5]: *Mabo* (n 1) 61.
[^6]: See, eg, *Western Australia v Ward* (2002) 213 CLR 1, [78]; *Wik Peoples v Queensland* (1996) 187 CLR 1. Cf *Members of the Yorta Yorta Aboriginal Community v Victoria* (2002) 214 CLR 422.
[^7]: Strelein, above n 4, 50.
[^8]: See ibid 52.
